correspondence: observed Camera-A person points to nearest translated surface anchor
robust_estimator: discard upper 20 percent correspondence distances then coordinate-wise median residual
valid_depth: finite positive registered person depth inside dataset person mask/ROI
depth_input_unit: HuMMan raw uint16 millimetres; observed points and internal correction use metres
registration_contract: RGB, color mask, K and the registered observed point cloud refer to Camera-A color coordinates
camera_b_use: held-out evaluation only; no Camera-B RGB inference and no Camera-B depth correction
